releaseNotesBody:
SinKey v1.0.17 — Installer Silent Update Fix

🔧 CRITICAL BUG FIX
- Fixed: Auto-update installer was not applying silently — the installer now passes both /S (NSIS) and --silent (Velopack) flags so updates work on all installer versions

Also includes v1.0.16 fixes:
- Plan upgrades from myfonts.lk now sync within 60 seconds
- Server revalidation syncs plan name, plan code, and device limit
- Immediate re-check when license expires (catches renewals/upgrade instantly)
